decision_rule: Per family: 'signature present' iff harden best-of-32 <= record + 1e-3 AND rigid best-of-32 > record + 1e-3 (record from catalog; pen/hex records as listed). Report exact bests regardless. This is the generalization test of the parent's n=11 finding.
hypothesis: The n=11 rare-event signature (harden reaches the record, rigid does not) is square-specific: present for squ-in-squ, absent for tri/pen/hex. Null (all four show it) is equally reportable.
question: Does the n=11 hardening signature generalize across convex shapes?
title: Convex rare-event sweep at n=11
